description: TY2025 single: income 30,000 / 15,060 = 199.20% FPL -> tier 150-200%: 0 + 2.00 x 4,920/5,000 = 1.97% -> contribution 591; PTC = min(6,000, 6,000 - 591) = 5,409. APTC 6,000 -> excess 591, but the SS 36B(f)(2)(B) cap for unmarried under 200% FPL is $375 (Rev. Proc. 2024-40 SS 2.07) -> repayment $375.00.
